source_meta._title: The pick block function doesn't work with entities while in survival or adventure mode

stor.environment: Unmodified Minecraft Java Edition 1.7.10 client in a new singleplayer world. Use Creative mode with cheats enabled only to prepare the deterministic test area and inventory, then enter Survival mode before placing and targeting the item frame. No particular seed, coordinates, difficulty, server, resource pack, or graphics setting is required by the report.
preconditions: Use the exact recommended version, Minecraft Java Edition 1.7.10; do not open the test world in a newer version.

The client must have an input assigned to the Pick Block action. The default input is pressing the mouse wheel/middle mouse button, but the configured binding must be used if controls have been changed.
Cheats must be enabled so the historical 1.7.10 /give and /gamemode commands can be executed in chat.

Before triggering Pick Block, one placed item frame must be visible, one additional Item Frame item must remain in the player's hotbar or inventory, and the selected hotbar slot must contain an item other than an item frame.

steps.action: Start the Minecraft Launcher, select or create an installation for the exact Java Edition version Minecraft 1.7.10, and launch it without gameplay-altering mods.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft 1.7.10 main menu is displayed.

steps.action: Open Options -> Controls and locate the Pick Block action. Confirm that it has an assigned input; its default is the middle mouse button, also described as pressing the mouse wheel. Do not change the binding unless no input is assigned. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki%3AProjects/Indonesian_translation/Persediaan?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The executor knows the exact configured input that will issue Pick Block later in the procedure.

steps.action: Return to the main menu and select Singleplayer -> Create New World. Set Game Mode to Creative, open More World Options, set Allow Cheats to ON, and optionally select the Superflat world type to provide a simple level test area. Create the world.
steps.exact_input: Singleplayer -> Create New World -> Game Mode: Creative -> More World Options -> Allow Cheats: ON -> Create New World
steps.success_cue: A new singleplayer world is loading with the player initially in Creative mode and commands available.

steps.action: Wait before continuing until the terrain around the player is rendered and movement and camera controls respond normally.
steps.success_cue: Nearby terrain is visible and the player can move and look around without world-loading interruption.

steps.action: Press T to open in-game chat, type the exact historical command shown, including the leading slash, and press Enter. This gives the nearest player exactly two Item Frames; item frames used numeric item ID 389 before the Flattening. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Talk%3ACommands/Archive_1?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The player's inventory contains a stack of exactly two Item Frames.

steps.action: Press T again, type the exact command shown, including the leading slash, and press Enter. This gives two Stone blocks: one will become the item frame's support and the other will be held during the trigger. Stone used numeric ID 1 in this version. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Talk%3ACommands/Archive_1?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The inventory contains exactly two Stone blocks in addition to the two Item Frames.

steps.action: Press E to open the inventory. Move the stack of two Item Frames into hotbar slot 1 and the stack of two Stone blocks into hotbar slot 2. The hotbar is the row of nine item slots at the bottom of the inventory and gameplay screen. Close the inventory with E.
steps.exact_input: E; Item Frames -> hotbar slot 1; Stone -> hotbar slot 2; E
steps.success_cue: Hotbar slot 1 contains two Item Frames, hotbar slot 2 contains two Stone blocks, and no other item occupies either slot.

steps.action: Press 2 to select the Stone in hotbar slot 2. Aim at the top surface of the ground and right-click once to place one Stone block above the ground. Leave at least one vertical side of this block unobstructed and accessible.
steps.exact_input: 2, then right-click once on the ground
steps.success_cue: One Stone block is standing above the surrounding ground with an exposed vertical side, and one Stone item remains in hotbar slot 2.

steps.action: Press T, enter the exact Minecraft 1.7.10 game-mode command shown, including the leading slash, and press Enter to switch the player to Survival mode. Numeric game-mode value 0 denotes Survival in the historical command syntax. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Talk%3ACommands/Archive_1?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The Survival HUD is visible, including health and hunger indicators, and the player is no longer able to use Creative flight.

steps.action: Press 1 to select the two Item Frames in hotbar slot 1. Face the exposed vertical side of the placed Stone block and position the crosshair over the center of that side from normal interaction distance.
steps.success_cue: The Item Frame stack is selected and visible in the player's hand, with a count of two, and the crosshair is on an exposed vertical face of the Stone block.

steps.action: Right-click once on the exposed vertical side of the Stone block to place one item frame while remaining in Survival mode.
steps.success_cue: An empty item frame is visibly attached to the Stone block, and one Item Frame item remains in hotbar slot 1.

steps.action: Press 2 to select the remaining Stone item in hotbar slot 2. Do not move or remove the remaining Item Frame item from hotbar slot 1.
steps.success_cue: The player is visibly holding Stone rather than an Item Frame, while one Item Frame item remains available in hotbar slot 1.

steps.action: Stand within normal interaction distance of the placed item frame and aim the crosshair directly at the center of the item frame entity. Adjust the view if necessary so the crosshair is on the frame itself rather than on an exposed portion of the Stone support block.
steps.success_cue: The empty placed item frame fills the center of the view, the crosshair is over it, Stone is still selected, and the spare Item Frame remains in hotbar slot 1.

steps.action: While keeping the crosshair on the placed item frame, issue the configured Pick Block action exactly once. With default controls, press the mouse wheel/middle mouse button once. Do not scroll the wheel, press a number key, open the inventory, or perform any additional input afterward. ([minecraft.wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki%3AProjects/Indonesian_translation/Persediaan?utm_source=openai))
steps.exact_input: Pick Block once; default input: middle mouse button
steps.success_cue: One Pick Block input has just been sent while the player is in Survival mode, Stone was selected, a spare Item Frame was present in hotbar slot 1, and the crosshair targeted the placed item frame entity.

stor.handoff_condition: Immediately after step 14, hand control to the observation subsystem before issuing any further input. The player must remain in Survival mode facing the placed item frame, with the Pick Block input just completed and the hotbar state left untouched for evaluation.
uncertainties: The report lists 24w44a in both Affects versions and Fix versions. It was omitted from affected_versions because the report and comments identify 24w44a as the fixing version, and fix versions must not be selected for reproduction.

The formal reproduction steps use Survival mode even though the title and description also mention Adventure mode. This plan follows the simplest deterministic formal path and tests Survival mode only.

The command-based item acquisition, Stone support block, Creative setup phase, and optional Superflat world are practical execution choices; the report requires only two item frames, Survival mode, a placed frame, a non-frame item selected, and Pick Block targeted at the frame.
No seed, coordinates, difficulty, multiplayer server, or exact camera distance was supplied by the report.
A rebound Pick Block control must be used instead of the default middle mouse button if the local control configuration differs.
